Staff Professional Services Operations Manager
Working Student HR & People Operations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omegga, we're on a mission to reinvent how AI and spectroscopy can drive positive change for animals, people and the planet. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive in-ovo sex detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche, we're building for the global standard.

Today, our systems are already in use, and the focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. For us, scaling means more than growth. It means changing an industry for the better.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Mission

You'll work directly with our Head of Finance&HR and keep the people side of Omegga running while we scale. This is not a "help out where needed" working student role. You own recurring processes end to end, and you get real responsibility from week one.

  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Own the operational employee lifecycle. Prepare contracts and documents, coordinate equipment and accounts, run structured first days, and manage clean offboardings.

  • Personio: Keep our HR system the single source of truth. Maintain employee data, absences, digital personnel files, and documentation quality, and help us get more out of the tool than we do today.

  • Recruiting Support: Draft and publish job ads, keep our applicant tracking system clean, coordinate interview scheduling, and own candidate communication so no application goes unanswered.

  • Recruiting Day: Organize our candidate day end to end: invitations, agenda, materials, interviewer briefings, and on site coordination.

  • Internal Events: Plan and run internal formats, from team events to company offsite

  • Development Budget: Take ownership of our people development budget. Build the process and guideline from scratch with us, then run it: track requests and spend, support colleagues in finding the right trainings, and keep it transparent.

  • Performance & Review Process: Help us prepare the rollout of our company wide review cycle. You build templates, timelines and tooling, and drive the internal communication around it.

Your Profile

  • Enrolled student (Bachelor or Master), around 16 hours per week during the semester, more during breaks if you want to. We plan in weeks, not fixed days, so exams and lectures can be accommodated as long as recurring processes stay covered. Ideally for at least 12 months. Your field of study is open. Business, psychology, law or something entirely different. What matters is that you care how people work in a company, not which lecture hall you sit in.

  • Some practical experience in HR, recruiting or operations, ideally somewhere that moved fast. We don't need an HR certificate. We need structure and judgment.

  • You catch what others miss. The missing signature, the wrong start date, the empty field in Personio. In HR, sloppy data becomes someone's problem three months later.

  • Discretion is second nature. You handle contract and personnel data without ever making it a topic.

  • You'd rather fix a process than repeat it. New tools don't scare you (Personio, Ashby, Notion, Google Workspace), and manual work twice in a row makes you build something better. You close loops without being asked. You structure your own week, decide when a decision is needed, and you push back when someone tries to bend a process.


Not ticking every box? That's okay. One exception to the above: German at C1 level or above is required for this role.
If this role excites you and you bring most of what we've described, we want to hear from you.

Why Us

Mission & Technical Challenge: At Omegga, you work on problems that are both technically demanding and globally relevant. We build deep-tech solutions with real-world impact, pushing the boundaries of what's currently possible.

Real Ownership: You won't be doing research tasks on the side. You run processes that the whole company touches, and you'll see the results of your work in how the whole team experiences Omegga.

Work Environment: Located in Munich's Werksviertel, we combine a focused, high-performance culture with flexibility. Most of our work happens in the office, remote work is possible depending on the task.

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

We work directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities, design and implement AI-powered development workflows, and scale what works across engineering organizations. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products, reusable architectures, and technical patterns that help developers everywhere get more value from Codex.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. Success is measured by production systems, sustained developer adoption, and meaningful improvements to how engineering organizations build software—not simply successful demonstrations or enablement activity.

Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Verträgen Umsatz wird: gemeinsame Kampagnen, Enablement, regelmäßige Pipeline-Reviews.Sichtbarkeit: Du vertrittst scaile auf Konferenzen (OMR, DMEXCO, Bits & Pretzels und Co.), bei Verbänden und Partnerevents.
  • Feedback ins Produkt: Du bringst zurück, was Konzerne, Tech-Partner und Verlage wirklich brauchen, und arbeitest dafür eng mit Gründern, Head of GTM und Sales.

Requirements

  • Erfahrungen in Partnerships, Business Development, Enterprise Sales oder Strategieberatung, idealerweise im SaaS-, Martech- oder Medienumfeld.
  • Du hast nachweislich Partnerschaften mit großen Unternehmen aufgebaut und zum Laufen gebracht. Nicht nur unterschrieben.

  • Reisebereitschaft in Europa + USA. Du arbeitest strukturiert mit CRM und AI Tools

Benefits

  • 70 Base; 100 OTE.
  • Du besitzt das Thema Partnerschaften komplett und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung.
  • Referenzen, die Türen öffnen: UniCredit, Axel Springer, Beurer, Lyceum Technologies, rund 50 weitere.

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC (SoHo) office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

  • You avoid ownership and accountability

  • You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on our software and processes.

  • Practical experience with at least one major Cloud Service Provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and a deep understanding of its core concepts.

  • Willingness to work collaboratively within a team, share knowledge, and contribute to a positive engineering culture.

  • A pragmatic and autonomous approach to programming and problem solving

Requirements

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production environments.

Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap.

Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux premiers entretiens.

CONTEXTE :

Vous intégrez le Service Contrôle de gestion Siège et Associations Nationales (AN), dont le rôle est d'accompagner les directions et associations nationales dans le pilotage financier, budgétaire et analytique de leurs activités. Il assure la production des reportings financiers, la consolidation des données du réseau, le suivi des risques financiers et l'amélioration continue des outils et processus de gestion.

Votre future équipe est constituée de 8 collaborateurs (7 à Lyon, 1 au Luxembourg), avec un périmètre international stimulant (interactions avec les États-Unis et l'Allemagne).

OBJECTIFS DU POSTE :

Ce poste permet d'avoir deux dimensions complémentaires :

- la valorisation et la fiabilisation des données financières,

- et le pilotage financier d'un portefeuille comprenant prioritairement l'Association Nationale UK.

Cette articulation vise à renforcer la qualité de l'information, l'automatisation des reportings et l'aide à la décision.

L’objectif est de structurer, fiabiliser, analyser et mettre à disposition les données utiles au pilotage, tout en assurant le suivi budgétaire, financier et des risques du périmètre confié. Le poste transforme les besoins métiers en indicateurs et tableaux de bord exploitables, accompagne les responsables budgétaires et contribue à l'amélioration continue des processus et systèmes d'information financiers.

Ce poste permet de transformer les données complexes en véritables outils d'aide à la décision !

Actions

jobs.title: Customer Care France - Accounting
jobs.description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


➡️ Mission

Join us as a Customer Care Manager to help French solo entrepreneurs get the most out of Qonto's brand-new accounting offer. You'll own their day-to-day questions in Zendesk , working under the guidance of Janita, Lead Customer Service, on a scope you'll help shape from day one.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own the ticket queue: Answer French solo entrepreneurs' questions by email and chat, and hop on the phone when a topic calls for it.
  • Bridge with our accountants: Take over client requests handed off by our accountants so they can focus on the accounting itself.
  • Build the playbook from scratch: Create FAQs, macros, and better ways of working, since this scope is brand new.
  • Feed insights back to Product: Flag recurring issues so the team fixes the root cause, not just the ticket.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • You learn fast: You've picked up complex, technical topics on your own before — no accounting background needed, just the appetite to learn it.
  • You're fluent in French: Native or near-native fluency, both written and spoken.
  • You're organized under pressure: You juggle email, chat, and calls without letting anything slip.
  • You're customer-obsessed: You naturally put yourself in the client's shoes before answering.
  • You're AI-curious: You don't need to be an AI power user yet, but you're open to using it in your day-to-day.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • A ground-floor seat on a brand-new, high-visibility initiative.
  • Real ownership over process: you'll help build the FAQs, macros, and workflows for this scope, not just follow them.

➡️ Your future manager

You'll report to Janita Käyhkö, Customer Care Lead at Qonto. She grew from CSM into a multi-team leader across Lyyti, Regate, and now Qonto (following Regate's acquisition). She's built processes from scratch and knows how to dig into complex client problems. She’s an empathetic manager who gives her team the context and autonomy to own their projects, and expects them to bring solutions.

At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
 
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

  • Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements.

About the Role:
 
As an Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.
 
By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.
 
This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.
 
Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.
 
This is a hybrid role, in office 3 days a week in Paris.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
  • Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
  • Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
  • Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
  • Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
  • Sell Competitively: Position Aircall’s value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer’s unique business needs.
  • Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
  • Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
  • Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

    • Qualifications:

  • Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
  • Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
  • Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
  • Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
  • Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
  • Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.

Impecto Consulting ist eine Beratung aus Düsseldorf für Industrieunternehmen mit gewachsenen Prozess- und Systemlandschaften. Unser Thema ist Produktinformation von der Anforderung bis zum Service: die Prozesse und Systeme, die Informationen aus Entwicklung und Konstruktion durchgängig bis in Dokumentation und Service tragen – PLM, ALM, ERP, Redaktionssysteme, Verwaltungsschale. Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen zur Geschäftsführung.

Aufgaben

Du leitest bei unseren Kunden die Umsetzung von Vorhaben rund um Produktinformation und die Systeme, in denen sie entsteht und genutzt wird – bei Konzernen ebenso wie im Mittelstand. Du begleitest die Fachbereiche durch Anforderungsaufnahme, Test und Migration und stimmst die Projektarbeit mit ihrem Tagesgeschäft ab. Darüber hinaus arbeitest du in unseren Orientierungs- und Entscheidungsprojekten mit, in denen wir Vorhaben vor der Umsetzung aufsetzen: Du sichtest Systemlandschaften, bewertest Anbieter und planst den Weg in die Umsetzung. So begleitest du Projekte von der ersten Einordnung bis in den Betrieb.

This isn't a CFO-strategist role, and it isn't bookkeeping.

It's for a hands-on generalist who understands accounting deeply, executes relentlessly, and is happy to go invoice-by-invoice in the morning, build the company budget in the afternoon, and model financials in the evening. You'll do things that don't scale at first to learn the business inside out, automate them away with tooling and AI, and grow into a true business partner to Sales and Marketing — the person with a 360° view of Solve.

  • Payments (AP): Own supplier payments end-to-end — approval workflows, invoices paid on time, duplicates and double-payments caught before they happen — and lead vendor negotiations on everything from software to office space.

  • The Monthly Close & Metrics: Run our external accountants to an accurate, on-time close every month. Own our financial metrics — definitions, reporting, the single source of truth — and work hand-in-hand with the CEO on communicating them to the board and investors.

  • Modelling & Big Decisions: Build the financial models behind our biggest calls — office leases, hiring plans, marketing budgets — and get stuck into special projects like M&A (we've already made two acquisitions this year).

  • International Finance: Own the finance side of operating and expanding across three countries (and counting): budgets for new office setup, transfer pricing, and international tax, working with our external advisors.

  • Cash & Treasury: Steward the ~$60M we've raised: payroll and vendors always paid, cash put to work safely.

💡 About Solve Intelligence

We are the fastest-growing startup transforming Intellectual Property. Our AI platform handles everything from invention harvesting and patent generation through to litigation and licensing.

  • Growth: 20–30% MoM revenue growth; 8 figures of ARR just ~2 years since launch.

  • Backing: ~$60M from Y Combinator, 20VC, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and the founders of top companies like Stripe, Perplexity, Tinder, Deel, Hugging Face, and Canva. See our Series B announcement.

👋 Who You'll Work With

You'll be joining a founding team with deep pedigree:

  • Sanj (CRO): PhD in AI (Gatsby Unit, UCL), ex-Huawei R&D, former lead at Magic Carpet AI (acquired).

  • Chris (CEO): PhD in AI (UCL), published researcher, ex-Dyson and Alan Turing Institute.

  • Angus (CTO): MEng Computer Science, ex-Qualcomm and Coremont (Brevan Howard).

🚀 Who You Are

We are a high-performance culture. To thrive here:

  • You get your hands dirty: You'll happily go line-by-line through invoices, the CRM, and the bank to make things clean — then automate the process so it stays clean.

  • You're detail-obsessed: Duplicate invoices, overdue payments, wrong pricing — nothing gets past you.

  • You have high agency: There's no playbook and no finance team behind you (yet). Give you an ambiguous problem and you'll work it out: find the mess, own it, fix it.

  • You're a business partner, not a back-office cop: You work close to Sales, Marketing, and the wider team, helping everyone spend smarter and move faster. You know the highest-leverage thing finance can do here is accelerate growth — nudging our treasury yield from 2.7% to 2.9% is not the job.

  • You're all-in: Solve is fast and intense, and this isn't a 9–5. You get passionate — even obsessive — about the problems you own.

  • You're ambitious: You'll do the dirty work now because you want to build the finance function as we scale.

🛠️ What You Bring

  • 5+ years in finance or finance-heavy operations at high-growth tech companies — e.g., FP&A lead/head, finance ops, or a generalist operator with a finance spike — now hungry for broader scope.

  • Deep fluency in accounting — you can run external accountants to an on-time close — without needing to be an accountant yourself.

  • Tooling mastery: Experience with modern finance stacks (e.g., ERP/accounting, spend management, billing & AR systems), and experience leveraging AI across everything you do (Claude Code/Cowork, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc).

🎁 What's In It For You?

Job Summary

We’re looking for a highly technical, systems-minded Senior Product Manager to lead two critical search intelligence teams: Machine Learning & Recall and Query. Search at Constructor is fundamentally an ML challenge, and this role sits at the absolute entry point of our discovery pipeline, right where shopper intent meets candidate retrieval.

In this role, you will bridge the Query team (understanding what a shopper means across intent, entities, and language) with the Machine Learning & Recall team (retrieving the exact right set of candidate products across massive catalogs). You will define strategy across both domains, balancing state-of-the-art techniques, such as vector search, semantic parsing, dense embeddings, and LLM-assisted query interpretation, with low-latency production execution. You won’t be measured on shipping features for the sake of it; you’ll be measured on candidate quality, query accuracy, and driving business outcomes like conversion rate, search-attributed revenue, and revenue per visit.

  • Set a unified roadmap: Define the multi-quarter vision and strategy across both the Machine Learning & Recall and Query teams, ensuring query understanding and candidate generation evolve hand-in-hand.

About the role

Relay's network runs on forecasts. Every shift released in sortation, every middle-mile van dispatched, every last-mile route planned, every expansion decision made - all downstream of models that predict how parcels move through our system. When those models are right, the network runs efficiently and cost per parcel drops. When they drift, the cost compounds across every stage of the operation. The Network squad builds and maintains the forecasting engine that powers all of it, and Demand Forecasting is its core: one forecast of what will be available to sort, at outcode granularity, from D0 out to D30.

As a Staff Data Scientist, you are the technical anchor for Demand Forecasting. You own the hardest and most ambiguous parts of the forecast, and you set the methodology and validation standards the rest of the area works to. That means owning the single integrated forecast of what volume the network will have to move, by area and out to thirty days, which the demand-management layer then turns into the operational plan the sort centres and transport teams run on. It means owning the model-driven end of that forecast, where the horizon runs past any live tracking data and expected parcels have to be generated from models rather than observed. It means owning the forecast of inbound international volume, one of the hardest prediction problems we have. And it means owning the models that predict each parcel's size and weight, which turn a parcel count into the physical volume that actually has to be sorted and loaded.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time building, not managing. You set the direction for how Demand Forecasting models, evaluates and ships its work, and you raise the technical bar across the area, but you do it as the most senior individual contributor in the room, on the tools. You'll work alongside a Senior Data Scientist who owns the domestic volume forecasts, an ML Engineer who keeps the models running reliably in production, and an Analyst who owns forecast accuracy and data quality. People leadership, strategy and cross-squad priorities sit with the Data Science Manager who leads the squad; you own the science.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 Data Engineers, Analysts, and Data Scientists, with specialists embedded into squads across the business. You will sit in the Network squad and report into the centralised data team. Demand Forecasting is growing, and as its Staff DS you will have the deciding voice on its technical direction and the modelling approaches it adopts.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrated forecast end to end. Blend live tracking signals in the near term with model-generated parcels further out into a single view, by area, from today to thirty days ahead. This is the view the demand-management layer turns into the plan that Sortation, Middle Mile and Last Mile actually run on.

  • Build the hardest models in the area. The model-generated long-horizon forecast, the inbound-international volume forecast, and the parcel size and weight models that make the forecast a measure of physical volume rather than just a count. These are the ambiguous, high-leverage problems, and they are yours.

  • Set the methodology and validation standards for Demand Forecasting. Define how models are evaluated, how accuracy is measured at each horizon (a forecast made thirty days out shouldn't be held to the standard of one made two days out), and what "good" looks like across the area's models.

  • Raise the technical bar. Review approaches, make the model-choice and build-vs-buy calls, and mentor the Senior Data Scientist and Analyst alongside you, without taking on their line management.

  • Define the forecast's interfaces. Decide what Demand Forecasting hands to the demand-management layer, to Routing, and to the network-planning function: at what granularity, with what guarantees, and how error is attributed when a number turns out wrong.

  • Learn the operational processes your models serve, supported by the squad and the teams who use the forecasts, and identify where the current approach falls short.

  • Own production quality across the estate, working with the ML Engineer so that models are monitored, drift is caught early, and accuracy problems are traced to the right cause rather than re-tuned blindly.

  • Work with Finance, who extend the operational forecasts into longer-range financial projections, to keep the handoff between operational and financial models reliable.

  • Quantify the impact of model error on cost per parcel, and use it to decide where the area invests effort.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You have been the technical anchor on a modelling team before. You've owned the hardest problems, set the standards others worked to, and been the person the team turned to when an approach needed a call. You did it hands-on, as a senior IC, not by moving into management, and that's the path you want to keep on.

You think in interconnected systems. A demand forecast isn't just a number; it drives how many shifts are opened, how many vans are dispatched and how routes are planned, and it feeds a downstream planning decision and the network's expansion models. You care about how your models connect to the models around them, and you design their interfaces deliberately.

A deep track record of building and delivering models from ambiguous starting points. You understand the problem, build something useful, validate it against real operations, and iterate. You evaluate models well beyond standard offline metrics, connecting outputs to downstream applications and business KPIs and measuring how improvements translate into operational impact.

Strong Python and SQL, and depth across the full modelling lifecycle - from data extraction and feature engineering through training, validation and production deployment. You've worked with time-series forecasting across classical statistical approaches, gradient boosting and deep learning, and you understand the trade-offs well enough to make and defend the choice for a given problem. You'll be supported by a dedicated ML Engineer, but you set the standard for how the area's models are built.

You know a model isn't done when it trains well; it's done when it's running, monitored, and trusted.

You communicate with non-technical stakeholders with authority. The squads that consume the forecasts need to trust them, and that trust comes from explaining what the models do, where they're reliable, and where they're not, without hiding behind the maths.

You're comfortable using AI tools - LLMs, code assistants, and similar - to accelerate your workflow, from exploratory analysis to code generation, and you're curious about where these tools can augment the modelling process itself.

This role suits someone who wants to see whether their models made a real difference to how the network operates. There is a direct feedback loop between your work and operational outcomes, and as the Staff DS you own the most consequential end of it.

Just avoid big mistakes and don’t make the same mistakes twice, and learn from them quickly. Worry less about failing and more about losing momentum in your feedback loop.   • Use research, data, and feedback from users and developers to identify access friction and prioritize improvements with the greatest potential impact.
  • Improve how sessions are established, maintained, and ended, balancing reliable access with account protection, privacy, and user control.
  • Shape device connection, session transfer, and partner authorization experiences, including clear consent when an app requests access or additional capabilities.
  • Partner with engineering to make session and access capabilities reusable and easier to adopt through APIs, client components, documentation, and clear integration guidance.
  • Work across client, device, and partner teams to understand different needs, align priorities, and carry improvements through delivery and adoption.

  • You have strong product and user experience judgment and enjoy working with design, research, and engineering to make complicated interactions easier to understand and use.
  • You can reason through technical trade-offs with engineers and translate complex product and technical decisions into clear language for different audiences.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced data engineering leader to help develop our data engineering community of practice, define data standards across the organisation and be part of the team delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy. 

The role: What you will do: 

  • Lead, manage and develop the Data Engineering team, building capability, resilience and strong ways of working.
  • Own PHMG's core data platform, architecture, data warehouse and associated pipelines, ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable and cost-effective.

  • Establish and embed strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, code review, documentation, monitoring and error handling.
  • Work closely with the wider Data team to translate the Data Strategy and business priorities into an effective engineering roadmap and delivery plan.
  • Work closely with IT, Infrastructure and other engineering teams on architecture, integrations, migrations and platform decisions.
  • Identify and evaluate opportunities to improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of PHMG's data capability, including the use of emerging technologies.

This is an exciting role for an experienced data engineering leader who has: 

  • Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing Data Engineering teams.
  • A strong track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms, solutions and architectures.
  • A thorough understanding of modern ETL/ELT practices and experience designing scalable, reliable and maintainable data pipelines.
  • Advanced working knowledge of SQL and Python.
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift or BigQuery. Experience within the Microsoft data ecosystem would be advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code review, monitoring and observability.
  • Strong experience of data modelling for reporting and analytics, using tools and approaches such as dbt or equivalent.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security and data management best practices.
  • Experience managing engineering delivery using agile ways of working.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have experience:

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once – from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools that sit at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll work on making sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets to hit our goals, help allocate those levers across markets, and dig into problem areas to find and fix root causes. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations – one for someone who's as comfortable building a model as they are diving into why a specific market is off plan.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations & courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

  • Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.
  • Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.
  • Allocate levers across markets: Own within-market supply lever allocation – translating high-level market planning into concrete, market-specific plans.
  • Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.
  • Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.
  • Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

  • 3+ years experience in operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.
  • Proficiency in Looker, SQL, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling is a must; other relevant analytical tools are a plus, including Python, Cursor, and Claude Code.
  • An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious – always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.
  • The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders  – both local and global.
  • A true culture champion – someone who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • You are located in either Berlin or Helsinki with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office. 

Next steps

What to expect from our hiring process:

  1. Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.
  2. Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.
  3. Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.
  4. Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Senior Account Executive (AE) to play a pivotal role in the growth and expansion of our business. You will be tasked with proactive outbound prospecting and managing inbound leads. Given the technical nature of our product, a high technical aptitude is crucial to understand and articulate the value proposition effectively to potential clients. You will be responsible for the entire sales cycle, including the initial prospecting, qualification, technical discussions, pricing and contract negotiation, deal closure, and expansion. This role demands a combination of technical understanding, sales acumen, and relationship-building skills to drive significant impact and contribute to the company's success.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Proactively build, qualify, and close a new logo sales pipeline, ensuring you meet or exceed quota and drive steady bookings growth.

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

  • Build and manage accurate forecast and opportunity progress reporting.

  • Partner with our Solutions Engineers to ensure technical alignment and convey NetBox Labs’ value proposition and key differentiators.

  • Continually seek to improve your selling skills and iterate/improve on the sales process.

  • Develop an understanding of the partner ecosystem and competitive solutions.

 
 

Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of SaaS/Networking Equipment field experience with quota-carrying roles in fast-paced markets, focused on closing net new logos and demonstrating the ability to run complex sales processes. Experience working with open source technology is a plus.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a collaborative startup environment.

  • An entrepreneurial and self-starter mentality with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get involved with many aspects of selling to “get it done”

  • A history of overachievement and consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Proficiency in managing both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline.

  • Drive and competitiveness, underlined by a strong desire to win.

  • Technical aptitude and exceptional ability to articulate the business value of complex, technical enterprise products built on open source technology. Previous experience as a sales engineer or network engineer is a plus.

  • Specialized knowledge in Networking, Network Engineering, Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

 

Compensation: €70K – €85K • Offers Equity • €70K – €85K Bonus

jobs.title: Strategic Tech Partnerships Manager
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1300 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 300,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

À propos du rôle

Chez Pennylane, les partenariats jouent un rôle clé dans notre capacité à accompagner les cabinets comptables et leurs clients avec une expérience financière toujours plus intégrée.

En tant que Strategic Partnerships Manager, vous serez responsable du développement d’un portefeuille resserré de partenaires stratégiques dans plusieurs catégories de produits. Votre mission sera de transformer ces partenariats en véritables leviers de croissance, en combinant animation commerciale, adoption produit et développement de notre écosystème.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success afin d’aligner les intérêts de Pennylane et de ses partenaires, et de générer une croissance durable chez nos clients communs.

Vos responsabilités

  1. Animer et développer un portefeuille de partenaires stratégiques

  • Gérer un portefeuille de 20 à 30 partenaires technologiques.

  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les interlocuteurs clés de vos partenaires : équipes commerciales, marketing, produit, direction et customer success.

  • Définir, avec chaque partenaire, une stratégie de développement adaptée à son potentiel, à son niveau de maturité et à ses priorités business.

  • Mettre en place des rituels de pilotage réguliers : business reviews, points d’avancement, plans d’action et suivi des engagements réciproques.

  • Identifier les opportunités d’upsell, de cross-sell et d’élargissement de la collaboration.

  1. Générer du business grâce au co-selling

  • Co-construire et exécuter des business plans annuels avec les partenaires prioritaires.

  • Développer des motions de co-selling efficaces entre les équipes commerciales de Pennylane et celles de nos partenaires.

  • Identifier, qualifier et faire progresser les opportunités commerciales issues de l’écosystème partenaire.

  • Structurer les processus de génération, de partage et de suivi des leads et opportunités.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes Sales pour accélérer la conversion des opportunités et maximiser le MRR généré.

  • Organiser des actions commerciales communes : campagnes ciblées, événements, webinars, contenus ou opérations de prospection conjointes.

  1. Accélérer l’adoption produit et l’usage chez les clients communs

  • Suivre la santé des intégrations et des parcours communs entre Pennylane et ses partenaires.

  • Stimuler l’adoption de nos intégrations et l’augmentation du nombre d’utilisateurs actifs chez les clients communs.

  • Identifier les freins à l’activation, à l’usage ou à la rétention, puis coordonner les plans d’action avec les équipes concernées.

  • Mettre en place des indicateurs de suivi de l’usage et partager régulièrement les analyses avec les partenaires.

  • Contribuer à améliorer l’expérience client sur l’ensemble du parcours, de l’acquisition à l’utilisation quotidienne des solutions connectées.

  1. Devenir l’expert de vos catégories de produits

  • Développer une compréhension approfondie des catégories de produits et des marchés couverts.

  • Devenir le référent interne et externe sur les acteurs, tendances, cas d’usage et dynamiques concurrentielles de votre périmètre.

  • Comprendre la stratégie produit et commerciale de chaque partenaire afin d’identifier les opportunités d’alignement avec Pennylane.

  • Faire remonter les besoins et retours du marché aux équipes Product, Engineering et Marketing.

  • Contribuer à prioriser les évolutions d’intégration et les initiatives communes avec les partenaires.

  • Aider les équipes internes à mieux comprendre la valeur et le positionnement des solutions partenaires.

  1. Mener une chasse stratégique ciblée

  • Cartographier l’écosystème français et identifier les acteurs stratégiques encore absents de notre portefeuille.

  • Qualifier les partenaires présentant le plus fort potentiel pour Pennylane, nos clients et notre stratégie produit.

  • Construire des approches d’engagement personnalisées auprès de ces acteurs.

  • Négocier et signer de nouveaux partenariats à fort impact.

  • Développer progressivement ces nouvelles relations jusqu’à leur activation commerciale et produit.

Vos indicateurs de performance

  • Croissance du MRR sourced et influenced sur vos catégories de produits.

  • Nombre d’utilisateurs actifs connectés via les intégrations partenaires.

  • Taux d’adoption et d’utilisation des intégrations chez les clients communs.

  • Taux de rétention, notamment la Net Revenue Retention, des clients utilisant les intégrations dédiées.

  • Nombre de partenaires accompagnés avec succès du Tier Silver au Tier Gold.

  • Contribution des partenaires aux objectifs de croissance de Pennylane.

  • Nombre de nouveaux partenaires stratégiques signés et activés.

  • Satisfaction et niveau d’engagement des partenaires prioritaires.

Le profil recherché

  • Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en partenariats stratégiques, business development, account management ou écosystème SaaS.

  • Vous avez déjà géré des portefeuilles de partenaires ou de comptes stratégiques avec des objectifs de croissance mesurables.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans des environnements impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et équipes : Sales, Product, Marketing, Customer Success et Direction.

  • Vous savez construire une relation de confiance tout en gardant une forte orientation business et résultats.

  • Vous avez une bonne compréhension des mécanismes de co-selling, de génération de leads et de développement commercial indirect.

  • Vous êtes capable de structurer un plan d’action, de prioriser vos efforts et de piloter plusieurs initiatives en parallèle.

  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’analyse de données et le suivi de KPIs commerciaux et produit.

  • Vous savez évoluer dans des contextes complexes, avec des cycles de décision parfois longs et plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Vous avez d’excellentes capacités de communication, de négociation et de présentation.

  • Vous êtes fluent en français et en anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Les qualités qui feront la différence

  • Orientation résultats : vous aimez transformer une relation partenaire en impact concret pour le business.

  • Esprit stratégique : vous savez prendre de la hauteur, identifier les bons leviers et construire une vision commune.

  • Leadership transversal : vous êtes capable d’embarquer des équipes sans lien hiérarchique direct.

  • Culture produit : vous aimez comprendre les usages, les intégrations et les problématiques des utilisateurs.

  • Rigueur et autonomie : vous structurez votre activité et assurez un suivi fiable de vos engagements.

  • Sens du collectif : vous privilégiez la collaboration et cherchez à construire des relations durables, en interne comme en externe.

  • Curiosité sectorielle : vous aimez comprendre un marché, ses acteurs et ses évolutions.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien RH avec Nathalie, Talent Acquisition - 30 mins

  2. Entretien Manager avec avec Chloé - Partner Team Lead - Connectivity - 45 mins

  3. Étude de cas à réaliser chez soi, suivie d’un débriefing avec Chloé + 1 membre de l'équipe - 1h

  4. Last Round avec Arnaud - General Manager Connectivity - 45-mins

  5. Team Fit avec l'équipe Tech partnerships + Marketing - 30 mins

Nous tenons également à souligner que nous adhérons pleinement aux principes de diversité, d’équité et d’inclusion, et que nous mettons tout en œuvre pour créer un environnement sûr et inclusif.
Nous nous engageons à offrir l’égalité des chances en matière d’emploi, sans distinction de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique qui fait de vous ce que vous êtes. Au contraire, la diversité rend notre lieu de travail encore plus agréable.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins enclines à postuler que d’autres si elles ont l’impression de ne pas répondre à l’ensemble des critères.

 

Si vous hésitez, nous vous encourageons à postuler : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d’une collaboration enrichissante et durable.

Que faisons-nous pour faciliter votre vie professionnelle ?

🌴 Quel que soit votre lieu de travail, vous bénéficierez de 25 jours de congés payés par Pennylane

💵 Vous bénéficierez d’une rémunération compétitive

📈 Vous recevrez des actions de l’entreprise pour profiter d’une part de la réussite que vous construisez avec nous

🏡 Vous disposerez d’un budget pour transformer votre domicile en un espace de travail plus confortable, ainsi que d’une allocation mensuelle pour travailler dans un espace de coworking quand vous le souhaitez

⛹️ Grâce à notre partenaire Gymlib, vous aurez accès à 8 000 salles de sport en Europe et à plus de 300 activités liées au bien-être

🇬🇧 Vous aurez accès à Busuu pour perfectionner votre anglais ou votre français
